payload.title: M4 Platform hardening: import and export, account isolation review, adoption docs
payload.description:
Outcome: a second publication can adopt newsletters from the docs alone, and subscriber data can move in and out.

Scope:
- Subscriber import (with consent provenance: Mailchimp, Substack, CSV) and export.
- Review of SES account isolation: whether busy sites need their own sending account or dedicated IPs, based on M1-M3 reputation data.
- Operator runbook (warm-up, suppression review, pausing a site, deliverability incidents) and the site-enablement guide.

Done when: a second Papyrus site enables newsletters by following the docs, without changes to Papyrus code.
